A king once lost everything to a few grains of rice.
You invented chess? Name your reward!
Just rice. One grain on the first square, then double it on every square.
Square one: one grain. Square ten: five hundred and twelve. Square twenty: half a million.
Square thirty-two: two billion grains. About fifty tonnes of rice.
Square sixty-four: over nine quintillion grains. More rice than humans have ever grown.
Never underestimate doubling. Tag your smartest friend.
